notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
List of fixes:


 FPS limit actually works now
 Low/Medium settings no longer turn otter into blurry mess
 Mode selection no longer bugs out when pressing left/right


Please enjoy and post any other bugs you find onto the forum!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone! Thanks so much for being fans of the game and following us on the journey. We've been working hard on the game since September and wanted to update the demo to reflect some of the progress we've made so far. 

The biggest changes you'll notice in the demo:


 Improved Options Menu: better UI and added options to toggle on/off vibrations, and change FPS limit.
 Better Tutorials: Improved tutorials for different mechanics of the game.
 Bug Fixes: We stopped a few hard crashes and fixed a few UI glitches.
 Gameplay Tuning: Pacing has been increased a bit, and the clam bomb radius has been slightly decreased.
 Time Attack Mode Improved: Our goal is to make Time Attack mode the ultimate "hardcore" challenge mode of the game, and I think the new tuning of the mode hopefully reflects that. Newly added is that each new wave spawns a "time bubble" that must be touched to add on extra time, instead of just instantly adding new time to the player. 


We are hoping to finish the full game sometime in the spring now as we are now focusing on adding more levels and enemies to the game. Follow our twitter @pinkhousegames or bluesky @pinkhousegamer for more updates on progress!
